svg.title: batch-assessment

g.text: assess_facilities (tools/assessment/facilities.py): the whole chain for every listed facility, in code, as one tool call.
Blue: steps. Green: the tools each step invokes. Grey: facilities that leave the chain. Red: early return.
an invalid CAS number ends the call here
